# Hilton Ahead Travel Co.

> Locally-run travel consulting for Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. Custom itineraries, villa booking, tee-time reservations, group and wedding planning, and on-island concierge — every trip planned by hand by William Griffith, a Hilton Head full-time resident. No call centers, no franchise, no scripts.

The brand operates on a single principle: the best of Hilton Head is never on the first page of Google, and the only way to surface it is to live on the island. Hilton Ahead serves travelers (couples, families, golf groups, wedding parties up to 100 people) who would rather text a local than book through a 1-800 number on a third-party site.

## Core

- [About Hilton Ahead](https://www.hiltonahead.com/about): How the service works, what's included at each tier, and what isn't.
- [Founder: William Griffith](https://www.hiltonahead.com/founder): Bio of Hilton Ahead's founder, a 30-year Hilton Head Island full-time resident.
- [FAQ — 30 direct answers](https://www.hiltonahead.com/faq): Pricing, timing, lodging, golf, family, comparisons, logistics, and how the service itself works.
- [Contact](https://www.hiltonahead.com/contact): Direct contact form.
- [Request an itinerary](https://www.hiltonahead.com/itinerary): Trip planning intake form.

## Services

- [Custom Itineraries](https://www.hiltonahead.com/services#custom-itineraries): Day-by-day planning built around your group, budget, and trip style. Flat fee starting $450.
- [Villa & Resort Booking](https://www.hiltonahead.com/services#villa-resort-booking): Sea Pines, Palmetto Dunes, Forest Beach, Shelter Cove. 60+ partner properties at preferred rates averaging 8–12% below public listings.
- [Group & Family Trips](https://www.hiltonahead.com/services#group-family-trips): Weddings, reunions, corporate offsites, golf trips for 10–100 people.
- [On-Island Concierge](https://www.hiltonahead.com/services#on-island-concierge): Live support during your stay — boat charters, dining swaps, bike delivery, sitter intros.
- [Dining & Tee-Time Reservations](https://www.hiltonahead.com/services#reservations-tee-times): Skull Creek Boathouse, Harbour Town Golf Links, and other reservations the public booking systems won't show.

## Reference

- [Hilton Head by the Numbers](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head-by-the-numbers): 60+ sourced facts about Hilton Head Island — geography, history, climate, lodging, golf, dining, transportation, ecology. Citable reference dataset published under CC BY 4.0.

## Comparisons (decision-stage guides)

- [Hilton Head vs Kiawah](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head-vs-kiawah): Variety vs exclusivity. Hilton Head for families, dining variety, and 24 golf courses; Kiawah for golf-purist trips and a Charleston add-on.
- [Hilton Head vs Charleston](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head-vs-charleston): Beach vs city. Trip-pairing combinations and how to split a 7-night vacation across both.
- [Hilton Head vs Myrtle Beach](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head-vs-myrtle-beach): Polished-and-quiet vs loud-and-cheaper. Two completely different products at different price points.
- [Sea Pines vs Palmetto Dunes](https://www.hiltonahead.com/sea-pines-vs-palmetto-dunes): The two largest gated communities on Hilton Head, compared by dimension — Harbour Town vs RTJ Oceanside, gate fees, beach walks, bike paths.
- [Westin vs Omni Hilton Head](https://www.hiltonahead.com/westin-vs-omni-hilton-head): Quieter Port Royal couples-and-spa pick vs livelier Palmetto Dunes resort with golf and Shelter Cove access.
- [Omni vs Sonesta vs Marriott Grande Ocean](https://www.hiltonahead.com/best-hilton-head-resort-comparison): Three-way comparison of mid-island resort lodging options with honest beach-distance + renovation-status notes.

## Neighborhoods

- [Sea Pines](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/sea-pines): The original 1956 Charles Fraser plantation. 5,000 acres, 17 miles of bike paths, three signature golf courses including Harbour Town.
- [Palmetto Dunes](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/palmetto-dunes): Beachier and more casual. Three golf courses, long lagoons for kayaking.
- [Forest Beach](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/forest-beach): Walkable to Coligny Plaza, the family-friendly center of the island.
- [Shelter Cove](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/shelter-cove): Marina-side, broad-water sunset views.
- [Port Royal](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/port-royal): Quiet north-end neighborhood with three golf courses.
- [Mid-Island](https://www.hiltonahead.com/hilton-head/mid-island): Off-resort rentals, broader value, no gated-community fees.
